echoParts: and you shall call his name Jesus
for he will save his people
verseText: She will bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.
meaning: These are the words the angel said to Joseph in a dream. The angel was telling Joseph that Mary's baby would save the world from sin.
